title: Build and Compose Shapes
description: Cut and combine triangles and squares to build larger shapes, then describe each new shape using sides and corners.
learningFocus: Compose a square from four triangles and a rectangle from two squares, then describe the new shapes by their sides and corners.
adultGuidance: Have your child arrange the pieces before gluing and ask how they know the pieces make the target shape. Four triangles make a square with 4 sides and 4 corners; two squares make a rectangle with 4 sides and 4 corners.

seo.title: Build and Compose Shapes | Grade 1 Math Worksheet
seo.description: A free printable Grade 1 worksheet for composing a square and rectangle from smaller shapes and describing sides and corners.
